title: 第014章 “我怕她多想。”
slug: 醉酒亲错人年下弟弟失控发疯
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

洗手间里除了舒楹没别人，他的声音响起来，轻易就捕获了她的心神。

方才酝酿的句子在喉咙里打转，她掩住听筒，极快地说道：“卢元遥对你意图不轨，你自己小心。”

她言尽于此不想再和谢亭渝有交集，但她正要挂断电话，谢亭渝冷声道：“舒楹，你以什么立场提醒我？”

舒楹踌躇着不知道该怎么回答，那头的谢亭渝就换了话锋，给她留了两个字：“等着。”

舒楹一愣。

听筒里的声音有了变化，她好像听到谢亭渝在和卢元遥。

“要跟我聊什么？A家的代言人你够不着。”谢亭渝依旧是冷淡的，一出口就能把人气死。

卢元遥犹犹豫豫地凑到他身边，“我找你难道就只是为了这些吗？”

嗓音清甜，好似含了委屈般令人混淆。

舒楹自认性格糟糕，个人审美很喜欢甜妹，可惜她生活中遇到的甜妹总是浮于表面，次数多了她也有些麻木。

“上次的事情是我不对，我说了要把那套首饰还给你，你不要，我走的时候不小心错拿了你要送给你……女朋友的礼物。”

“她……该不会因为这个生你的气吧？”

舒楹越听越糊涂，难道谢亭渝真的跟卢元遥有不可告人的关系？

这时，谢亭渝笑了一声，像是故意要让她听到一样，“你觉得，你能影响到我和未婚妻的关系？”

“对不起。”卢元遥识趣地向他道歉，“我只是……太喜欢你了，谢亭渝。你真的不能给我一次机会吗？”

话落，舒楹许久都没听到他们出声。

氛围进行到这里，一阵喘息声突兀地响起，随后便是悉悉索索的动静。

她听得不真切，以为自己间接旁听了不可告人的秘事，心脏猛地一缩。

谢亭渝为什么非要她听这个？

舒楹手忙脚乱地想挂断电话，谢亭渝却仿佛在她身上装了监控，恶狠狠地说道：“你敢挂一个试试！”

骤然抬高的分贝吓了舒楹一大跳。

电话那头兵荒马乱的，不知道是不是卢元遥被人带走了。

她手一顿，脑子里乱糟糟的想不明白他们一男一女到底发生了什么。

这一系列的事情对她来说太超过了。

舒楹深吸了一口气，准备到外面透透气。

Page (1/3)

There was no one else in the bathroom except Shu Ying. His voice rang out and easily captured her mind.

The sentence she had just been preparing was swirling in her throat. She covered the receiver and said very quickly: "Lu Yuanyao has evil intentions towards you, so be careful."

She said that she didn't want to have anything to do with Xie Tingyu anymore, but when she was about to hang up the phone, Xie Tingyu said coldly: "Shu Ying, from what standpoint do you remind me?"

Shu Ying hesitated and didn't know how to answer. Xie Tingyu on the other end changed the subject and left her two words: "Wait."

Shu Ying was stunned.

The voice in the receiver changed, and she seemed to hear Xie Tingyu talking to Lu Yuanyao.

"What do you want to talk to me about? You can't reach the spokesperson of Family A." Xie Tingyu is still cold, and he can make people angry to death as soon as he speaks.

Lu Yuanyao approached him hesitantly, "Is this just why I'm looking for you?"

The voice was sweet and sweet, as if it contained grievances and was confusing.

Shu Ying considers herself to have a bad personality, and she likes sweet girls personally. Unfortunately, the sweet girls she meets in life are always superficial, and she becomes a little numb after too many times.

"What happened last time was my fault. I said I would return that set of jewelry to you, but you didn't want it. When I left, I accidentally took the gift you wanted to give to your...girlfriend."

"She...won't be angry with you because of this, right?"

The more Shu Ying listened, the more confused he became. Could it be that Xie Tingyu really had an ulterior relationship with Lu Yuanyao?

At this time, Xie Tingyu laughed, as if he wanted her to hear it on purpose, "Do you think you can affect the relationship between me and my fiancée?"

"I'm sorry." Lu Yuanyao apologized to him sensibly, "I just... like you so much, Xie Tingyu. Can you really not give me a chance?"

After the words fell, Shu Ying didn't hear them speak for a long time.

At this point in the atmosphere, a gasping sound suddenly sounded, followed by rustling sounds.

She didn't hear it clearly, thinking that she was indirectly listening to some ulterior secret, and her heart suddenly shrank.

Why did Xie Tingyu insist on her hearing this?

Shu Ying hurriedly tried to hang up the phone, but Xie Tingyu seemed to have installed a surveillance camera on her body and said viciously: "You dare to hang up!"

The sudden increase in decibels startled Shu Ying.

There was chaos on the other end of the phone, and I didn't know if Lu Yuanyao had been taken away.

She stopped her hands, her mind was in a mess and she couldn't figure out what happened to them, a man and a woman.

This series of events was too much for her.

Shu Ying took a deep breath and prepared to go outside to get some air.
